summary: Brady Corp filed an 8-K reporting a Nov 4, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement with William H. Brady III, a Class B holder. Brady exchanged 1,769,314 Class B shares (all he owned) for 1,769,314 newly issued Class A shares, no cash consideration. Post-closing, director Elizabeth P. Bruno holds 100% of the Class B stock and thus controls all voting stock; disinterested directors approved, Bruno abstained. Brady will use commercially reasonable efforts to register resale; Brady accepted a 24-month lock-up with customary exceptions. Watch control-concentration and registration timing risks.
